name: Koutei Heika ni Narou!
source:
While our king was visiting his dying teacher, he found and released a girl sealed in a tree. It seems his teacher had sealed her because she came from the underworld. What he released was just her spirit. To get her body back, he has to find medals that his teacher gave to other kings. Well, he has four commanders to help him do that. He can also get some princesses too, if he want to.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
國王前去探望垂死的老師時，發現並釋放了一名被封印在樹中的女孩。看來，她來自冥界，因此才被老師封印。如今獲得自由的只有她的靈魂；要恢復身體，國王必須找回老師交給其他國王的勳章。好在他有四名將領從旁協助。如果願意，他還可以將一些公主收入麾下。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
